slides.title: Tumhara brain 24/7 kya kar raha hai? 🧠
slides.sub: Brain ke parts, emotions, memory, attention aur stress, ek hi post mein. Exam ke liye save karo 📌

slides.title: 5 exam topics, 20 slides
items: kaun sa hissa kya karta hai
dar, gussa, pleasure brain mein kahan
ye kaam brain ka kaun sa hissa karta hai
Brain sab kuch kaise jodta hai

slides.title: Ek rat ne ek ghante mein pedal dabaya
items: Jab tak thak ke gir nahi gaya
pedal dabate hi brain ka ek hissa use pleasure deta tha

slides.title: Brain stem: life support
items: heart rate + breathing control. Akela medulla bhi life chala sakta hai

slides.title: Thalamus: brain ka filter
items: senses ki info filter karke cortex tak bhejta hai; neend mein senses band
stimulate karo to jaanwar turant fully awake: alertness

slides.title: Cerebellum = little brain
items: damage ho to chalna, balance, haath steady rakhna mushkil
cerebellum par asar daalta hai, isliye ladkhadana

slides.title: Rat ka secret: Hypothalamus
items: needs poori hone par pleasure ki feeling

slides.title: Dar aur gussa kahan se aata hai?
items: fear aur aggression; threat dikhe to sabse active
gusse ka brake: zyada active = zyada self-control

slides.title: Hippocampus = brain ka librarian
items: info thodi der rakhta hai, phir cortex mein store karwata hai
nayi yaadein ban hi nahi paati

slides.title: Memory ke 3 alag address
items: facts, events: jo hum jaan-boojh ke yaad karte hain

slides.title: Party mein ek awaaz kaise sun lete ho?
items: shor mein bhi ek hi baat par focus
kisi ne aapka naam liya to turant sun lete ho

slides.title: Planning aur judgement ka boss
items: learning, judging, moral reflecting, spatial reasoning: jo humein insaan banate hain

slides.title: Neurons ki chemical chat
items: electrical signal neuron ke andar daudta hai
synapse (gap) par chemical messages: neuron se neuron tak
synapses badalte hain jab hum seekhte hain

slides.title: 2 hemispheres, 1 bridge
items: left brain right body ko control karta hai, aur ulta
dono hemispheres ko jodne wala bridge
brain flexible hai: naye connections, naye neurons

slides.title: Body ka accelerator vs brake
items: stress mein body ready: dil tez, pupils dilate, paseena
body calm: dil aur saans dheemi, recovery
ek gas, ek brake: balance = health

slides.title: Stress aate hi body mein kya hota hai?
Immunity kamzor, zakhm dheere
items: thought, emotion, behaviour poori body badalte hain

slides.title: Ek nazar mein revision
items: reward, hunger · Amygdala: fear · Prefrontal: control
new memory · Stress: HPA → cortisol → GAS
